required_evidence: Explicit project acquisition/download/collection of research inputs, with local actor or demonstrated research-data acquisition instruction.
does_not_qualify: Dependency/software download; mention of a dataset alone; unrelated third-party activity.
synthetic_positive_example: Download the sensor observations into data/raw before running the study.

required_evidence: Explicit generation/measurement/recording of observations used as research data.
does_not_qualify: Model outputs merely called data; generic application logging.
synthetic_positive_example: This simulator generates synthetic observations for the trials.

required_evidence: Repository documents collected observations and identifies their collection process, subjects, sensor or experiment.
does_not_qualify: Bundled files or a paper link without a collection statement.
synthetic_positive_example: responses.csv contains responses collected from the study participants.

required_evidence: Explicit data-cleaning/filtering/normalizing/tokenizing transformation and a research-input object.
does_not_qualify: Installation/configuration; generic data analysis; archive unpacking unless the codebook explicitly includes it.
synthetic_positive_example: The preprocessing script removes invalid sensor readings.

required_evidence: Explicit extraction/encoding/merging/resampling/splitting of research inputs into analysis-ready representations.
does_not_qualify: Pre-existing feature files alone; metric computation; any transform without a research-data object.
synthetic_positive_example: Extract features from the recordings and split them into training and test sets.

required_evidence: A documented command with a stated data-preparation purpose and input/output relation.
does_not_qualify: A filename such as clean.py without purpose; shell unpack command alone.
synthetic_positive_example: To normalize the measurements, run python prepare.py --input raw.csv --output normalized.csv.

required_evidence: Explicit implementation of a named model/algorithm/analytical method linked to this repository.
does_not_qualify: Imports/dependencies alone; code accompanying a paper without identifying a method.
synthetic_positive_example: This library implements a Bayesian estimator of the model parameters.

required_evidence: Documented fitting/training/inference/optimization of a scientific model on research inputs.
does_not_qualify: Generic computation, a train.py filename alone, or unrelated functionality.
synthetic_positive_example: Train the classifier on the study data with the documented fitting command.

required_evidence: Documentation identifies a local routine and explains its scientific computational role.
does_not_qualify: A generic src/analysis folder; treating every experiment script as Method.
synthetic_positive_example: estimate_posterior computes posterior parameter samples for the stated statistical model.

required_evidence: Explicit runnable procedure to conduct or reproduce a stated research experiment.
does_not_qualify: Experiment as a background topic; dataset-only archive; application startup.
synthetic_positive_example: Run the provided command to reproduce the experiment reported in the study.

required_evidence: Documented research trials over seeds, conditions, parameter configurations or ablations.
does_not_qualify: Any for loop; software unit tests; tuning application settings without a research experiment.
synthetic_positive_example: Repeat each experimental condition for ten random seeds.

required_evidence: Local experimental script/protocol explicitly connected to research conditions and resulting outputs.
does_not_qualify: Only plotting existing results; references to experiments elsewhere.
synthetic_positive_example: The trial script executes the two treatments and writes the response measurements.

required_evidence: Explicit computation/reporting of a scientific metric or uncertainty measure for research outcomes.
does_not_qualify: Any mention of results; unit-test pass rate; a filename evaluate.py alone.
synthetic_positive_example: Compute prediction error and a confidence interval on the held-out observations.

required_evidence: Explicit comparison of research outcomes against reference labels, baselines, methods or experimental conditions.
does_not_qualify: Generic runtime logging, software tests or a citation to another evaluation.
synthetic_positive_example: Compare the model against the baseline using the reported test-set F1.

required_evidence: Documented evaluation command or quantitative table/figure whose assessed quantity and comparator/criterion are identified.
does_not_qualify: Generating an arbitrary figure, reproducing unspecified outputs, or a section title alone.
synthetic_positive_example: The table compares the two models using test error and runtime.

required_evidence: Explicit repository-associated public deposit/release of research outputs, with an identifiable output and destination.
does_not_qualify: Software DOI alone; license/release badges; repository existence.
synthetic_positive_example: The study outputs are archived at the stated public data deposit.

required_evidence: Documentation explains creation/export of research figures, tables or a scientific report for communication/reuse.
does_not_qualify: Generic plots unrelated to research; software documentation alone.
synthetic_positive_example: Generate the publication figures from the experimental results.

required_evidence: Explicit association with a paper or citation metadata; record as paper_association evidence. Promotion to the stage requires a resolved codebook decision.
does_not_qualify: Do not silently equate every paper reference with dissemination; current reference examples differ.
synthetic_positive_example: This repository accompanies the linked research paper.

required_evidence: Executable acquisition call with research-data context and downstream storage/use in the same routine or a bounded data-flow relation.
does_not_qualify: An HTTP call/import alone.
synthetic_positive_example: observations = fetch(dataset_url); save_observations(observations)

required_evidence: Executable synthetic-data generation or sensor/participant observation recording feeding research inputs.
does_not_qualify: Generic logs or model predictions alone.
synthetic_positive_example: observations = simulator.sample(n); save_dataset(observations)

required_evidence: Executable cleaning/filtering/normalization/tokenization of identified research inputs.
does_not_qualify: Generic string/config parsing.
synthetic_positive_example: features = scaler.fit_transform(measurements)

required_evidence: Executable feature extraction/encoding/merging/resampling/splitting connected to research data.
does_not_qualify: Named files or imports without the operation.
synthetic_positive_example: train, test = split_dataset(observations)

required_evidence: Executable scientific model/algorithm/estimator with identifiable computational operations and scientific role.
does_not_qualify: A suggestive function name, import or comment alone.
synthetic_positive_example: parameters = solver.solve(scientific_objective)

required_evidence: Executable fitting/training/inference/optimization on research inputs.
does_not_qualify: A dependency declaration or generic application prediction with no scientific context.
synthetic_positive_example: model.fit(research_features, target_observations)

required_evidence: Executable trial loop/runner over research conditions with a scientific call and recorded outcomes.
does_not_qualify: An arbitrary loop, application configuration or software test runner.
synthetic_positive_example: for seed in trial_seeds: results.append(run_trial(condition, seed))

required_evidence: Executable research parameter search/ablation with explicit configurations and model/trial evaluation.
does_not_qualify: Search import alone or production tuning without a research purpose.
synthetic_positive_example: search = GridSearchCV(estimator=model, param_grid=conditions); search.fit(X, y)

required_evidence: Executable metric/statistical operation using research outcomes and a reference/criterion.
does_not_qualify: A variable named accuracy or unit-test assertion alone.
synthetic_positive_example: score = f1_score(reference_labels, predictions)

required_evidence: Executable baseline/method comparison, uncertainty estimation or hypothesis test linked to research results.
does_not_qualify: Logging elapsed time by itself.
synthetic_positive_example: comparison = compare_methods(baseline_results, method_results)

required_evidence: Executable figure/table/report export with traceable research-result inputs.
does_not_qualify: savefig with no research-output context; README file creation.
synthetic_positive_example: export_figure(plot_results(trial_results), output_path)

required_evidence: Executable deposit/publication operation whose payload is identified research output.
does_not_qualify: A URL string or software release operation alone.
synthetic_positive_example: archive.publish(research_outputs, metadata)
